items.text: Subscribers per 1,000 views are at 0.8 against a usual 1.8, the one fragile check. In E12 DesignerTom gained 2.6 per 1,000 views and Dive Club only 0.9.
items.recommendation: Add a spoken subscribe ask on Dive Club right after the strongest guest segment, and pin a subscribe link in chat on both channels. Next week, compare the Dive Club rate with DesignerTom's.

items.text: The announce-to-play reading is 21.8 against a usual 26.5, and it has softened across the last 5 clean episodes. Fewer people who see the announce are pressing play.
items.recommendation: Rewrite the next announce to open with the guest's name and one concrete takeaway. Post it as a short clip on both channels and compare plays with this week's announce.

items.text: Search and suggested videos bring a share of 7.7 against a usual 14.3 for the show. E2 reached 20.8, while E12 reached only 6.7.
items.recommendation: Test a title built around the one question a viewer would search, such as portfolio reviews or the job market. Add chapters and a plain description, then compare the share with E2's.

items.text: E14, still in its first weeks: 4.9 of every 100 viewers left a little over halfway in, during a long look at one portfolio's layout. About a third in, 5.1 extra viewers per 100 were watching, during a talk about taking work.
items.recommendation: Test capping each portfolio walkthrough to a few minutes and moving the career-advice talk earlier. Then check whether the drop a little over halfway in shrinks. Treat it as a test, not a certainty.

items.text: Chat is healthy: 79.6 chatters per 100 against a usual 53.9, and 123 messages an hour against 72.2. Messages an hour have still softened over the last 5 clean episodes.
items.recommendation: Open each guest segment with one chat question and read a few replies on air, on both channels. Keep it up for several episodes to see whether messages an hour stop sliding.
